capabilities: Draw a two-ticker ratio chart in a ratio code block
Fit 200-, 400- and 1,000-day regression lines with standard deviation bands
Add a 14-day RSI panel and a 200-day z-score header
Replay the chart as of a past date
Cache Yahoo Finance daily closes for offline use
extras: Prices are cached in the plugin's own data file so notes open offline; no accounts, telemetry or analytics. Can be installed via BRAT before a community directory listing exists.
motivation: The author found relative strength easier to read as a single ratio line than as two price charts, and wanted the regression bands and z-score to give a stretched reading a number instead of an eyeball.
problem: Reading relative strength between two tickers from two separate price charts is hard, and there is no built-in way to measure how far a ratio has drifted from its trend.

relations.evidence: the windows of Bloomberg's Multiperiod AutoReg template
downloading daily closing prices from Yahoo Finance

summary: Code-block chart plotting one ticker's price divided by another's, with regression channels, standard deviation bands, RSI and z-score from Yahoo Finance.
